entity_title: Register within 4 months — late registration is fined
fact_text: EU/EEA citizens settling in Austria for longer than three months must apply for an Anmeldebescheinigung (EU registration certificate) at the settlement authority within four months of entry. Failing to apply in time is an administrative offence (Verwaltungsübertretung) punishable by a fine of EUR 50 to EUR 250.
evidence_quote: Die nicht rechtzeitige Beantragung einer Anmeldebescheinigung stellt eine Verwaltungsübertretung dar und ist mit Geldstrafe von 50 EUR bis zu 250 EUR zu bestrafen.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed EU free movement means no paperwork. Actually the Anmeldebescheinigung must be applied for within 4 months of entry and late registration is an administrative offence (Verwaltungsübertretung) fined EUR 50 to 250 (NAG §§53/77). Action: apply at the settlement authority within 4 months.
